notes.title: Happy Holidays Patch
notes.notes:
Hello All! 

Huge thanks to all of you for the great feedback and for reporting bugs to us! We hope all of you enjoy the holidays and this new patch. Full list of changes below:

Changelist:
Added a new item upgrade tier, total of 3 now available. 3rd level unlocks when you reach the airlock. 
Game plus loop will now continue indefinitely, difficulty steadily increasing...it will get unbalanced at some point :)
Black hole grenade re-supply cost increased from 15 to 80.
Defeating bosses in new game plus will no longer display the “new boss challenge unlocked” message. Also, reward is raised to 1000 in new game plus.
With charge mod gun will no longer fire by itself once ammo is depleted but wait for user action.
Difficulty setting will have a more pronounced effect now.
Improved stability with Twitch.
Random minor bug fixes.


Happy Holidays!

notes.title: New Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello All! 

Our latest update is now live. Full changelist is below. Enjoy! 


Changelist

Updated controller aim sensitivity, less sensitive.
Increased controller deadzone range to prevent aim drift. 
Items and upgrades that you own can now be sold for the original amount you paid. This will allow you to experiment more in early game and switch between item upgrade levels.
New icons for buying and selling items/upgrades.
Changed how you add items to loadout with a controller from “A” to “LT”
Bullet spread is now tied to gun heat. As the gun heats up, accuracy will suffer progressively. Shorter burst and cooling help accuracy. 
Gun reticule will now dynamically scale and brighten up with more enemies on the screen to help visibility. (Steam only)
Improved Twitch Challenge stability. (Steam only)


We'd be keen to hear any feedback or thoughts you have! Thanks!

notes.title: Balance Patch
notes.notes:
Hello! 

Small balance patch went out this morning (PST). You can read the small changes below. Enjoy! 

Changelist:

- Crawler boss now gives twice the amount of points per segment killed, speeding up the grind some players experienced.

- You can now deny the Experiment 7 gun attack by landing enough shots on his arm in the short warning window. It’s difficult to pull off but you now have that extra option and it makes the gameplay more consistent.

Remember, we'd love to get more steam reviews if you could take a few minutes to write one we'd greatly appreciate it!
